index.meta.title: Centric Ecosystem — A Digital Ecosystem to Accelerate Your Business
index.meta.description: Centric offers 5 flagship digital products: Meet (AI Meeting), Hub (WhatsApp Gateway & CRM), Buzz (SMM Platform), Link (LinkBackSeed Aggregator), and Seekr (Career Platform for Jobseekers).
index.productsTitle: The right solution for every need
index.productsSub: Five flagship products designed to help your business grow in the digital era.
index.meetDesc: Turn your meeting recordings into structured notes, executive summaries, and action points automatically with AI. Save time and boost team productivity.
index.hubDesc: An all-in-one platform for WhatsApp Business API, CRM, AI chatbot, broadcast campaigns, multi-agent inbox, and sales automation built for Indonesian businesses.
index.buzzDesc: Grow your followers, engagement, and brand awareness instantly and organically. A complete SMM service for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X/Twitter, and more.
index.linkDesc: A LinkBackSeed aggregator platform that connects you with press and media providers. The backbone for your link-building, SEO, and content publication needs.
index.seekrDesc: Build an ATS-friendly CV, a standout portfolio, and cover letters, and track your applications — all with AI assistance in a single platform.
index.ctaBandDesc: Tell us about your business needs and we will help you pick the most suitable products — at no consultation cost.
index.featuresSub: We deliver complementary, integrated solutions that support your business growth.
index.f1Desc: Five products in one fully integrated ecosystem. No need to switch between platforms.
index.f2Desc: Data and workflows between products connect directly without friction for maximum efficiency.
index.f3Desc: Our specialist support team is ready to help whenever you need assistance or consultation.
index.f4Desc: Data security and privacy are a priority. All products are built to high security standards.
index.howSub: No hassle. Pick a product, sign up, and experience the benefits for yourself.
index.step1Desc: Identify your needs — whether it is an AI meeting tool, WhatsApp CRM, SMM panel, or link-building.
index.step2Desc: Registration is free. Pick the plan that fits your needs and start using the product within minutes.
index.step3Desc: Monitor your business progress in real time and enjoy consistent, steady growth.
index.testiSub: Thousands of clients have experienced the benefits of the Centric ecosystem.
index.faqSub: Find answers to the most common questions about our products and services.
index.faqCardDesc: Our team is ready to help you 24/7 at no consultation cost.
index.ctaFinalTitle: Ready to accelerate your business growth?
index.ctaFinalDesc: Choose the product that fits your needs. Sign up for free and start your business digital transformation today.
tentang.meta.title: About Us — Centric Ecosystem
tentang.meta.description: Learn more about Centric Ecosystem, an integrated digital ecosystem for accelerating your business.
tentang.heroDesc: Our mission is to provide an integrated digital solution ecosystem that empowers Indonesian businesses to thrive in the digital era.
tentang.whoTitle: A digital ecosystem built for growth
tentang.whoDesc: Centric Ecosystem is a suite of fully integrated digital products designed to help businesses in Indonesia operate more efficiently and grow faster.
tentang.whoP1: We believe the right technology can be a key catalyst in any business's digital transformation. Founded by professionals with deep experience in technology and digital business, Centric Ecosystem delivers a comprehensive suite covering meeting intelligence (Centric Meet), WhatsApp Gateway & CRM (Centric Hub), social media marketing (Centric Buzz), link-building aggregator (Centric Link), and a jobseeker career platform (Centric Seekr).
tentang.whoP2: Through an integrated ecosystem approach, we ensure every product can be used independently or together to deliver maximum value for our customers.
tentang.visionDesc: To become Indonesia's leading digital ecosystem that empowers every business to reach its full potential through innovative, integrated, and accessible technology solutions.
tentang.mission1: Provide high-quality digital products that are fully integrated with one another
tentang.mission2: Deliver a seamless and intuitive user experience
tentang.mission3: Support the digital transformation of Indonesian businesses with affordable solutions
tentang.mission4: Keep customer data security and privacy as a top priority
tentang.milestone1Desc: Centric Ecosystem was founded with the vision of creating Indonesia's first integrated digital product ecosystem, covering a wide range of business needs in a single platform.
tentang.milestone2Desc: Centric Hub (WhatsApp Gateway & CRM) and Centric Buzz (SMM Platform) were launched and received a positive response from thousands of users across Indonesia.
tentang.milestone3Desc: Centric Meet (AI Meeting), Centric Link (LinkBackSeed Aggregator), and Centric Seekr (Jobseeker Career Platform) joined to complete the ecosystem. We continue to innovate to deliver the best solutions for our customers.

privasi.meta.title: Privacy Policy — Centric Ecosystem
privasi.meta.description: Centric Ecosystem Privacy Policy — how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privasi.heroDesc: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privasi.cardDesc: Our team is ready to assist you regarding your data and privacy.
privasi.s1P1: This Privacy Policy explains how Centric Ecosystem ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, discloses, and protects your personal information when you use our website (customercentric.id) and related products, including Centric Meet, Centric Hub, Centric Buzz, Centric Link, and Centric Seekr (collectively, the "Services").
privasi.s1P2: By using our Services, you consent to the collection and use of information as described in this policy.
privasi.s2Lead: We may collect the following types of information:
privasi.s2Li1: Personal Information: Your full name, email address, phone number, and other information you provide when registering for or using our Services.
privasi.s2Li2: Usage Information: Data about how you interact with our Services, including pages visited, features used, and session duration.
privasi.s2Li3: Device Information: Device type, operating system, browser, IP address, and unique device identifiers.
privasi.s2Li4: Communication Data: Messages, files, and other content you share through our Services.
privasi.s3Lead: We use the collected information to:
privasi.s3Li1: Provide, maintain, and improve our Services
privasi.s3Li2: Process transactions and send related confirmations
privasi.s3Li3: Respond to your questions, comments, or complaints
privasi.s3Li4: Send updates, security notices, and support information
privasi.s3Li5: Detect, prevent, and address technical issues or misuse
privasi.s3Li6: Analyze usage trends to improve the user experience
privasi.s3Li7: Comply with applicable laws and regulations
privasi.s4P1: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include data encryption, firewalls, and strict access controls.
privasi.s4P2: However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.
privasi.s5Lead: We do not sell, trade, or transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except in the following situations:
privasi.s5Li1: To trusted service providers that help us operate the Services (e.g., hosting providers, payment processors)
privasi.s5Li2: When required by applicable law or regulation
privasi.s5Li3: To protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of others
privasi.s5Li4: In the context of a merger, acquisition, or sale of company assets
privasi.s6P1: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience, analyze trends, and manage the Services. You can control cookie usage through your browser settings.
privasi.s7Li1: Access the personal information we hold about you
privasi.s7Li2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
privasi.s7Li3: Request deletion of your personal data
privasi.s7Li4: Object to or restrict certain data processing
privasi.s7Li5: Withdraw your consent at any time
privasi.s7P2: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the contact information provided below.
privasi.s8P1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be announced through our Services and, if significant, via direct notice. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
privasi.s9P1: If you have any questions, complaints, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
privasi.ctaDesc: Our team is ready to explain how we protect your data.
